title: Q24 Crypto Guide Strategy (Quantiacs) — SMA15/34 + RSI14 long-only crypto daily
economic_hypothesis: the contest ranks on in-sample Sharpe above 1.0 and runs qualifying strategies in daily live paper trading; no per-strategy number is public
market: crypto daily spot, long only (contest rule)
assets: top-10 crypto by market capitalisation, recomputed monthly from coinmarketcap data, stablecoins excluded; the platform exposes it as the is_liquid field and hand-picking is forbidden
entry_rules: weight 1 where SMA(close,15) > SMA(close,34) AND is_liquid AND (RSI(close,14) < 34 OR RSI(close,14) > 68)
exit_rules: no stop is defined anywhere in the example; no profit target is defined; positions are re-evaluated every day; an asset that no longer satisfies the signal gets weight 0; the signal flipping to zero, i.e. either SMA condition or RSI condition failing
risk_rules: weight 1 on every qualifying liquid asset, normalised by the platform's cleaner (qnout.clean, competition_type='crypto_daily_long') into a long-only allocation; daily bars, no session constraint
parameters: SMA 15/34, RSI 14 with thresholds 34 and 68, daily rebalance
claimed_period: in-sample from 2016-01-01 (earlier data may be used for testing/training)
claimed_metrics: the page shows the statistics call but not its output; the contest requires an in-sample Sharpe above 1.0 for validity
transaction_cost_model: the page states no cost assumption; the statistics function decides what is charged
required_data: Quantiacs cryptodaily dataset (qnt.data.cryptodaily_load_data, min_date 2015-01-01) plus the is_liquid field
external_code: the published example, cloneable in the platform (the code is in the page)
external_results: the example's source code read verbatim, with the contest's own backtester as the evaluation harness
counter_evidence: the contest's own gate is in-sample Sharpe, which selects for overfitting and says nothing about costs
the page's benchmark download raised an HTTP 404 while being read, so even the benchmark call is currently broken
long-only by rule, so the strategy has no way to express a negative view
nothing about the example's realised live paper performance is public
the project's admission cost is a 23.791 bps round trip, and the source declares no cost model (the page states no cost assumption; the statistics function decides what is charged)
found in the RFC-035S2 strategy-first search; no local backtest influenced this record
replication_difficulty: PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNVERIFIED: a daily-rebalanced top-10 book with a slow SMA filter can keep turnover low enough to clear the 23.791 bps round trip, but the example states no cost model and no turnover, so nothing about net edge can be asserted from the source
evidence_quality: E2 — the example's source code read verbatim, with the contest's own backtester as the evaluation harness
selection_bias_risk: MEDIUM (the search was run with knowledge of 2024-2025 published results)
gaps_to_p0: no stop and no target: the exit is only the signal flipping
no cost model is published, so the 23.791 bps floor cannot be applied from the source
the data source is platform-bound (contest rule: only Quantiacs data may be used)
original metrics are not quoted in the page
rank_semantics: `rank` is frozen as assigned by the round that classified this candidate; `current_rank` is the rank in force after RFC-035S3

round_3_reclassification.reason: no existing result attributable to the code (only the contest threshold), un coste no declarado y tres campos ejecutables sin fijar: la evidencia económica se reclasifica por debajo de E2
